title: feat(app-shell): an action's preflight read draws a panel in the param dialog and seeds its params
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCKr3vPRjotMb1xrL6vwwA7)_

Fixes #31808

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:动作可以声明 `preflight`(#31859 已在 spec 落地):参数对话框在用户填好参数后,先向服务器发一次同源 GET 读取(例如「安装这个版本会改什么」),把结果作为面板显示在表单上方,并把答案里的值(例如确认令牌)自动填进对应参数,只读显示、提交时原样带上。
- **为什么改**:像「安装/升级应用包」这类动作,用户在确认前需要看到服务器算出的计划和风险,并带上服务器签发的令牌;之前只有 `ban_user` 一个写死的面板,元数据无法声明这种读取。
- **风险与回滚**:不声明 `preflight` 的动作与现在完全一样(`ban_user` 面板不变)。读取失败、答案缺字段、URL 某个占位符没有值、或声明被 spec 拒绝时,面板显示错误,被填充的必填参数保持为空,确认按钮不可用,不会发出半成品请求。参数改变后旧答案作废,迟到的旧答案不会覆盖新答案。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`(读取、面板、过期答案守卫)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogCompanion.ts`(用 spec schema 重新判定声明)、`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`(`preflightReadFiller`:URL 占位符填充)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.preflight-31808.test.tsx packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.preflightRead-31808.test.ts`,预期 17 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。字段标签暂按声明原文显示,翻译缺口见 #31885。

## What changes

- **`ActionParamDialog.tsx`** reads the declared block and drives one same-origin read:
  - the URL is filled by the runner's filler (below) from the dialog's CURRENT values; while a `${param.NAME}` hole has no value the panel says which params it waits on and nothing is sent;
  - the filled URL is re-checked with `isSameOriginApiTarget` before any request, and the read goes through `readElementApi` / `selectElementApiPath` from `@object-ui/react` with the host's `apiFetch`;
  - it is sent again whenever a param a hole reads changes the URL;
  - answers are stored with the URL they answer, and seeds are derived only from the answer to the current URL, so a change of URL clears the seeds at once. A ref guard drops an answer to a URL the dialog has moved on from, so a late answer cannot replace the current one;
  - the panel draws `preflight.fields` through the result dialog's `ResultField` (exported for this), and each seeded param is drawn read-only (`CarryOverParam`) and submitted verbatim;
  - seeds apply all or none: a seed path the answer lacks is a failed read. A failed read, a missing path, an unbound hole and a refused block each draw the panel's error state; the seeded params stay empty and their `required` mark keeps Confirm disabled.
- **`actionDialogCompanion.ts`**: `ParamDialogCompanion` is now a union of the host chrome `user-assigned-work` (the `ban_user` panel, unchanged) and the declared `preflight`. `resolveParamDialogCompanion` takes the action's `preflight`, `params` and the filler, and re-judges stored metadata with the spec's `ActionSchema` (`judgeActionPreflight`) before anything is read; a refused block is drawn as refused, never read.
- **`ActionRunner.ts`** (`@object-ui/core`): `ActionDef.preflight`, and a fifth `ParamCollectionHandler` argument `interpolateRead` (`PreflightReadFiller`). Of the brief's two options this is the second (the runner's context through the handler); `substituteScopeTokens` stays private and gains an optional `onMissing` callback. The filler binds `${param.NAME}` to the dialog's values, `${ctx.record.FIELD}` / `${ctx.recordId}` to the dispatched row or, on a record page's header dispatch, to the record the page shows (`this.context.record`); each value is percent-encoded, and a hole with no value or a scope the grammar does not know answers `null`, so nothing is sent. A target's own interpolation is unchanged.
- **Both handlers** (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`) forward `preflight: action?.preflight` and the filler to the resolver.
- **Forwards and mirrors** (surface additions approved by the seat): `preflight` in the four action renderers' runner payloads, `ACTION_DEF_KEYS`, and `ActionSchema.preflight` in `@object-ui/types` typed as `SpecAction['preflight']`.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: seven `actionDialog.preflight.*` keys (heading, waiting with `{{fields}}`, loading, unbound, refused, failed, seededHint) in every locale pack, `zh-Hant` regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`. Published through the `.` entry, hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`**: `preflight` and its children move from `planned` to `live`, citing the readers; `state-counts/action.md` regenerated.

### Extra files beyond the brief's surface (each approved by the seat)

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/{action-button,action-icon,action-group,action-menu}.tsx`: one-line `preflight` forward each.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`: the `ACTION_DEF_KEYS` row, and the stale `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` comment.
- `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`: `preflight?: SpecAction['preflight'];`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`: `ResultField` exported.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-forward-precedence.test.tsx`: a pin edited with the seat's approval, `'preflight'` added after `'resultDialog'` in `BUTTON_ORDER` and `ICON_ORDER`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`: regenerated by `gen:liveness-counts`.
- `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`: the eager `i18n-locale-en` chunk's ceiling raised from 61,000 to 62,000 gzipped bytes and its `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` row from 41,415 to 42,415, with the seat's approval after Build & E2E UI went red on it (job 129164310942: 59.7 KB against a 59.6 KB ceiling). See **The en catalogue budget** below.

## Tests

- `ActionParamDialog.preflight-31808.test.tsx` (new, 10 cases, a real `ActionRunner`, the real resolver and judge, a fake `apiFetch` through `SchemaRendererContext`): the cloud-shaped flow (waits for its params, reads once, draws the findings, submits the seeded token verbatim); a re-read on a param change seeding from the new answer; a stale answer dropped even when it arrives last; a change of URL clearing the seed until the new URL answers; a failed read and an answer without the seed path each blocking Confirm; a spec-refused block and a filled URL off this origin each refused before any request; an unbound `${ctx.record.FIELD}` hole sending nothing; CONTROL, the same hole on a record page header dispatch bound to the page record and read.
- `ActionRunner.preflightRead-31808.test.ts` (new, 7 cases): the filler reads the dialog's current values, percent-encoded; row binding over the page record; header binding to the page record; `null` for a missing or empty param, a missing record field, no record, and an unknown scope; CONTROL, a target still interpolates an empty hole as `''`.
- New `describe` blocks in `actionDialogCompanion.test.ts`, `useConsoleActionRuntime.banCompanion-30205.test.tsx` (the filler reaches the dialog as the fifth argument) and `RecordDetailView.banCompanion-30205.test.tsx` (a header dispatch binds `${ctx.record.name}` to the page's record); `ban_user` cases unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Runs at head 6f13e3e1</summary>

The merge of main `6a8f4151` touched the locale packs (recycle-bin keys) and app-shell's Setup pages; after it, the i18n package, every file under `core/src/actions/`, the touched app-shell harness files, `views/setup/` and the action renderer tests were re-run: `Test Files 230 passed (230)`, `Tests 3599 passed | 13 skipped`. `check-i18n-en-drift` exit 0 and `gen:zh-hant` left no diff. The runs below are at the branch commit `32447622` before the merge.

- `@object-ui/app-shell` whole package, `--shard=k/8` under the verify lock: 8/8 exit 0, 2220 files (2219 passed, 1 skipped), 20,324 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- `@object-ui/components` whole package, `--shard=k/4` under the lock (the seat asked for it): 4/4 exit 0, 479 files (478 passed, 1 skipped), 4,585 tests passed, 24 skipped.
- `@object-ui/core` + `@object-ui/i18n`: `Test Files 336 passed (336)`, `Tests 6249 passed | 40 skipped`.
- `@object-ui/types` whole package, run together with the action renderer tests: 425 of 426 files passed; the one red file was the components forward-order pin (4 cases), fixed by the seat-approved edit above and green in the components run.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (censuses, `check:spec-symbols`, `check-action-forward-parity` included): `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 5027 passed`.
- `packages/spec`: `scripts/liveness` + `action-preflight` + `page-element-api-data-source` tests, `Test Files 14 passed`, `Tests 482 passed`; `check:liveness` exit 0.
- `type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json` legs) for core, types, components, i18n and app-shell: exit 0 each.
- `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob a11215cd)</summary>

- The stale-answer guard `if (currentReadUrl.current !== url) return;` in the read's success callback removed: exactly the stale-answer case goes red (`1 failed | 9 passed`, "expected 'loading' to be 'ready'": the late answer to the old URL replaced the current one, so the dialog lost its current answer).

</details>

## The en catalogue budget

The seven `actionDialog.preflight.*` strings live in the eager `en` catalogue because the param dialog is eager. Measured with `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `ui/apps/console`, reading `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, twice on the same tree (`main` at `f3036900` merged in): with the keys the `i18n-locale-en` chunk reads 61,120 gzipped bytes (the same chunk hash as the red CI build); with those eleven `en` lines deleted it reads 60,963. So `main` sat 37 bytes under the 61,000 line and the keys cost 157. Following the objectstack#28124 precedent, the ceiling and its baseline each move by 1,000 (the need rounded up to a whole 1,000), with the measurement in a dated `⚠️ RAISED by objectstack#31808` comment; the other 843 bytes are shared headroom. The eager closure moved 2,258,725 → 2,258,885 (+160), well inside the aggregate ceiling. Nothing else moved: no other row, no exemption, no import made lazy. After the raise, `check:eager-closure` on a fresh build is green (59.7 KB / 60.5 KB) and the two budget test files pass (186 tests). #31926 (#31893) raised the same line by 1,000 too and landed first (`f6b89852`). After merging `main` at `c385d903`, the two `⚠️ RAISED` comments are folded into one naming both cards: ONE shared 1,000 covers both (#31893's 67 bytes + this card's 157), and the ceiling stays 62,000 with its baseline at 42,415. Re-measured on that merged tree, the chunk reads 61,199 gzipped bytes, 801 under 62,000; `check:eager-closure` is green (59.8 KB / 60.5 KB) and the two budget test files pass (186 tests).

## Acceptance notes

- **#31885 is open:** `preflight.fields[].label` has no bundle walker or overlay yet, so a label draws as authored in every locale. The liveness note names this gap; the seat ruled to flip the row to `live` in this PR.
- **An unbound hole** (a `${ctx.record.FIELD}` the dispatch cannot bind) leaves the read unsent and draws the error panel; the seeded params stay empty and Confirm stays disabled. No spec refusal is added for it (seat ruling).
- **No live verification:** the cloud read this is built for is not reachable from this container; the flow is pinned against a fake `apiFetch` that answers the cloud's shape.

## Verification

- **Head `49053f4b`** merges `main` at `c385d903` (the en budget comments folded, re-measured as above); on it the i18n package plus the touched core, app-shell and renderer files pass (216 files / 3437 tests) and `check-i18n-en-drift` exits 0.
- **Head `d929ee06`** added three commits on top of `6f13e3e1`: the seat's nit N1 (the `preflightReadFiller` doc comment moved off `dialogCopyFiller`'s method, comment-only), a merge of `main` at `f3036900` (clean), and the budget raise above. On it: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 170 passed / 2 skipped, the i18n package plus the touched core, app-shell and renderer files 216 files / 3437 tests passed, `check-i18n-en-drift` exit 0, `check:eager-closure` green on a fresh production build. Everything below ran at `6f13e3e1`.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 72 commands, the same list at both heads): all run at head `6f13e3e1`, reconciled with `--ran` (72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED), all exit 0. `check:generated` died in its unlocked run with `tsc -p … failed without diagnostics` (the heap, while other suites ran), and passed re-run alone under the verify lock with `--max-old-space-size=6144`, `check:test-typecheck` green. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed the pinned fixture commit fetched on this shallow clone.
- The PR-body gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`) ran against this body: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`: exit 0.
